final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT tradekind, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1 GROUP BY tradekind), step3 AS (SELECT s1.translink, s1.tradekind, s1.record_count, CAST(s1.record_count AS REAL) / s2.total_count AS proportion FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.tradekind = s2.tradekind COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(proportion) AS mean_proportion FROM step3 GROUP BY tradekind), step5 AS (SELECT s3.tradekind, s3.record_count, s3.proportion, s3.proportion - s4.mean_proportion AS excess FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s3.tradekind = s4.tradekind COLLATE BINARY WHERE s3.proportion > s4.mean_proportion) SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count), AVG(proportion), AVG(excess) FROM step5 GROUP BY tradekind
